Workflow: ' + ($json.workflow?.name ?? 'unknown') + '
Error: ' + ($json.execution?.error?.message ?? 'unknown error') + '

nodes.name: Send Alert
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL with a Slack incoming-webhook URL (or any endpoint that accepts JSON with a `text` field). Without this workflow wired up, a failed run dies silently — Fathom already got its 200 response and will not retry, so the call simply never appears in the tracker.
